newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's Canada Oil Sand to begin test production.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Canada Oil Sand to begin test production.

text.p: Japan's Canada Oil Sand Co Ltd plans to begin test production of 10,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) of crude oil from oil sands in Alberta, Canada, starting in 2001, a source close to the company said on Wednesday.
Canada Oil Sand hopes to begin commercial production of about 100,000 bpd of crude oil from 2008, an official with Japan Petroleum Exploration Co Ltd (JAPEX) said.
JAPEX is one of the 71 Japanese companies which provided capital to launch Canada Oil Sand in 1978.
The oil sands are located in Athabasca, the site of a major oil sands mine in northern Alberta.
Oil sand refers to crude oil mixed in sand, which is strip-mined and separated out via a refining process.
The JAPEX official said that Canada Oil Sand has started to ask its shareholders for a capital injection to help raise the funds necessary to begin test production.
